# Local Forge Media

> Local Forge Media is a digital growth agency for home service contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, electrical, landscaping, remodeling). One package, $2,500 per month plus ad spend: Meta ads, website redesign, local SEO and Google Business Profile optimization, and an AI receptionist and chatbot. Founder: Malakai Bubar. Custom website and marketing work is also available for businesses outside home services. No results are guaranteed; clients own their ad accounts and data.

Contact: info@localforge.tech, 470-935-2672. Book a call: https://calendly.com/aureliuskade08/local-forge-media-consult

- [Local Forge Media home](https://localforge.tech/): Services, the $2,500/month package, process, FAQ and contact for home service contractors.

## Guides

- [AI Receptionist for Contractors: What It Does and What to Know](https://localforge.tech/blog/ai-receptionist-for-contractors/): What an AI receptionist or website chatbot does for contractors: answer calls, qualify leads and book jobs. How to choose one, its limits, and the consent and recording rules to know.
- [Best Lead Generation Companies for Contractors: How to Choose (2026)](https://localforge.tech/blog/best-lead-generation-companies-for-contractors/): Not sure which lead generation company to hire as a contractor? Compare the main types, see what each costs and risks, and use a vendor checklist with red flags. Includes our own disclosure.
- [How Much Should a Contractor Spend on Marketing?](https://localforge.tech/blog/contractor-marketing-budget/): How much a home service contractor should spend on marketing: how to set a budget from your margins and capacity, what to include, and how to judge whether it is working.
- [Electrician Marketing: How to Get More Booked Jobs](https://localforge.tech/blog/electrician-marketing/): Electrician marketing for contractors: Google Business Profile, service pages, local SEO, Meta ads and follow-up that bring in panel upgrades, EV chargers and repair calls.
- [Google Ads vs. Local Services Ads for Contractors (2026)](https://localforge.tech/blog/google-ads-vs-local-services-ads/): How Google Ads and Local Services Ads differ for contractors: how you pay, who qualifies, what leads cost, the 2026 changes, and how to choose. Sourced and honest about the numbers.
- [HVAC Marketing: 8 Ways to Fill Your Schedule in 2026](https://localforge.tech/blog/hvac-marketing/): Practical HVAC marketing for contractors: Google Business Profile, local SEO, Meta ads, seasonal offers and call handling that turn searches into booked jobs.
- [Landscaping Marketing: How to Win More Yards](https://localforge.tech/blog/landscaping-marketing/): Landscaping marketing for contractors: project galleries, local SEO, Google Business Profile, seasonal Meta ads and recurring maintenance offers that fill your schedule.
- [Local SEO for HVAC Contractors: A Practical 2026 Guide](https://localforge.tech/blog/local-seo-for-hvac-contractors/): A plain-English guide to local SEO for HVAC contractors: Google Business Profile, service pages, reviews, citations and seasonal timing. What works, what to skip, and no ranking promises.
- [Plumbing Marketing: What Actually Brings In Calls](https://localforge.tech/blog/plumbing-marketing/): Plumbing marketing that works: Google Business Profile, local SEO, search and Meta ads, reviews and call handling for plumbers who want more booked jobs.
- [Roofing Marketing: How Roofers Get Leads Online](https://localforge.tech/blog/roofing-marketing/): Roofing marketing for contractors: local SEO, Google Business Profile, Meta ads for inspections, project galleries and follow-up that turn leads into signed jobs.
